title: BE cascades role create with Edit but no View (cascade integrity)
steps:
1. POST /api/roles with name='QA Bad Cascade' and fePermissions=['SCHEDULE_EDIT'] (Edit present, View absent).
2. Inspect the response status and body.
3. GET /api/roles/{id} for the returned role id and inspect the persisted fePermissions.
expected:
1. The API returns 201 Created (NOT 400).
2. The missing parent permission is auto-added server-side: SCHEDULE_VIEW is cascaded in alongside SCHEDULE_EDIT (Edit => View).
3. Fetching the role back shows the cascaded set (SCHEDULE_EDIT + SCHEDULE_VIEW); the incomplete Edit-only bundle is NOT persisted verbatim.
